title: Launch weather constraint
body: No launch through cumulus cloud > 4500 ft thick, anvil cloud within 10 nm, debris cloud, or surface electric field > 1500 V/m at any point along the planned ground track. Triboelectrification rule: no launch through clouds at temperatures between -15 °C and +5 °C.
citation: Range Safety Lightning Launch Commit Criteria (ELV/45SW)

title: Range safety FTS criteria
body: Flight Termination System shall be armed before liftoff. FTS commanded if: vehicle deviates > 3-sigma from nominal trajectory and crosses Iimit-of-overflight, vehicle telemetry lost > 30 s during powered flight, or impact prediction enters populated area.

title: T-0 hold criteria
body: Vehicle hold at any T < 60 s requires recycle of countdown to at least T-15 minutes. Hold-fire criteria include: any RP-1 / LOX vent failure, any non-rated parameter on red-line, any range safety asset failure, any crew/payload anomaly.
citation: Falcon 9 Launch Operations Plan; STS Launch Commit Criteria

title: SSME engine-out criteria
body: Single SSME engine-out at T+30 s allows mission completion via abort-to-orbit if SECO is reachable. Two engines out: RTLS or TAL (mission-specific). Three engines: contingency abort with low survivability — crew bailout option.

title: Max-q dynamic-pressure pitch program
body: Vehicle shall throttle down through Max-Q region (typically 30-90 s after liftoff) to limit dynamic pressure on airframe. Throttle reduction profile is mission-specific; deviation > 5 % from planned throttle triggers in-flight abort review.
